Regal.ai | Sr. Software Engineer | NYC Hybrid | Full-Time | https://www.regal.ai/

Regal is the AI Agent Platform — we power millions of outbound/inbound calls, SMS, and email interactions for enterprise customers like Google, AAA, and Coursera. $82M raised, $7B in revenue driven for customers, 250M+ calls completed.

We're hiring a Senior SWE to own backend systems end-to-end. You'll directly contribute to our voice agent infrastructure, build tooling to evaluate agents via simulations and enhanced observability, and ship cutting-edge AI features fast to large, active user bases.

5-12+ years of experience with production web-scale platforms. Python expertise required. AI/LLM experience a big plus.

Stack: Python, TypeScript/Node.js, React, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis, Kinesis, DynamoDB, AWS

Apply: https://jobs.lever.co/regalvoice/c8d4f421-4c8d-43b9-ae6d-16d...

Happy to answer questions here.
